name: Ōiso (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ōiso town emblem in maroon: an outlined trefoil of three lobes with small pointed strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Ōiso, a town in Kanagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 15 August 1964.

features.role: Ōiso town emblem — an outlined trefoil of three lobes with small pointed strokes
